description.value: Earls is a well-established Canadian casual-dining chain offering a full sit-down menu of North American dishes with a bar program. The Richmond location sits in a retail complex on No. 3 Road, the main commercial corridor through central Richmond. Table reservations and takeout pickup are both available, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through the area.
